title: Methodical
tagline: Every question deserves the right design.

suits.name: Describe
suits.ask: What is it? How much, how often, where, and is it changing?

suits.name: Explore
suits.ask: What is going on here? How and why do people experience or do it?

suits.name: Associate
suits.ask: Do X and Y go together, and does X come first?

suits.name: Cause
suits.ask: Does changing X change Y? Does the intervention work?

suits.name: Predict
suits.ask: What will happen, and to whom?

suits.name: Measure
suits.ask: Can we measure it accurately, reliably, and validly?

suits.name: Explain
suits.ask: What mechanism or law must hold? What follows from the theory?

suits.name: Build
suits.ask: Can we make something that works, and is the plan feasible?

suits.name: Synthesize
suits.ask: What does all the existing evidence say?

constraints.name: Can't assign
constraints.text: You can't (ethically or practically) decide who or what gets the exposure.

constraints.name: Rare outcome
constraints.text: The outcome is rare: roughly 1 in 1,000 or rarer.

constraints.name: Rare exposure
constraints.text: Only a small, identifiable group is exposed.

constraints.name: Long latency
constraints.text: Years or decades pass between cause and effect.

constraints.name: Brief trigger
constraints.text: The exposure is brief and its effect is immediate.

constraints.name: Existing data
constraints.text: Records, registries, logs or archives already exist.

constraints.name: One unit
constraints.text: Only one or a handful of units: one patient, one country, one factory.

constraints.name: Group-level
constraints.text: The exposure acts on whole groups, or would spill over between people.

constraints.name: Cutoff rule
constraints.text: A threshold on a score decides who gets the exposure.

constraints.name: Rollout
constraints.text: Everyone will get the intervention anyway; only the timing is flexible.

constraints.name: Tight budget
constraints.text: Weeks or months, not years; a small budget.

constraints.name: Uncharted
constraints.text: Little prior theory; you don't yet know which variables matter.

constraints.name: Practice-led
constraints.text: Practice runs ahead of research: most of what is known sits in blogs, white papers, talks and manuals, not journals.

constraints.name: Many studies
constraints.text: A substantial body of primary research already exists.
